title: End-to-end PDF to editable HWPX
outputContract: Versioned editable HWPX, source/semantic/asset/layout bindings, actual checks and unresolved ledger.
escalation: Resolve only missing source interpretation or required capability.

title: Source pages and crop coordinates
outputContract: Pinned source manifest, physical/logical mapping and region transforms.
escalation: Ambiguous printed order requires source review.

title: Printed vs student marks
outputContract: Typed marks, provenance claims, semantic owners and retained/excluded/unresolved map.
escalation: Do not infer provenance from intensity or a visually plausible drawing.

title: Image to semantic construction and SVG
outputContract: Source-backed topology, finite construction code, styled assets and unresolveds.
escalation: Source uncertainty and exact geometry constraints require separate treatment.

title: Bounded semantic geometry edits
outputContract: Typed patch against base revision, residuals and affected-node manifest.
escalation: Unsupported or degenerate construction requires a bounded extension.

title: Native text underline
outputContract: Source-bound underline spans and native text properties.
escalation: Repeated text requires explicit span offsets.

title: EqEdit symbols and normalization
outputContract: Normalized scripts and qualified native glyph bindings.
escalation: New command/version needs a focused native fixture.

title: Inline equation spacing and metrics
outputContract: Exact metric cache bindings and diagnosed spacing component.
escalation: Cache miss or changed font/native version requires exact new measurement.

title: Example and proof alignment
outputContract: Native aligned frame with source row/column ownership.
escalation: Mixed prose/blank/figure content should use native structured rows.

title: Whole-question copy/paste
outputContract: Question-to-table/descendant bindings plus focused scratch copy/paste evidence.
escalation: Package membership alone cannot establish clipboard behavior.

title: Repeated page template and local reflow
outputContract: Separate content/local-layout/template artifacts and overflow/page mapping.
escalation: Content overflow must be surfaced and resolved without changing meaning.

title: HWPX package structure and coverage
outputContract: Independent ZIP/XML/reference/coverage evidence on exact bytes.
escalation: Do not promote package validity to native appearance or source acceptance.

title: Native Hancom rendering/editability
outputContract: Owned native PDF/behavior receipt and actual limitations.
escalation: Missing instance ownership prevents attaching to existing user documents.

title: Tools, models and transport reuse
outputContract: Bounded role-appropriate tool/model route with actual readiness evidence.
escalation: Historical response, current authentication and native apply are different states.

title: Typed feedback, attribution and evaluation handoff
outputContract: FeedbackEvent, dependency trace, regression proposal, measured/null quality-cost-time fields.
escalation: Concurrent rubric remains externally owned; proposed contracts are not adopted results.

title: Knowledge release and source drift
outputContract: Immutable successor knowledge release and explicit source drift/curation receipt.
escalation: New evidence must be curated; never auto-promote an updated file to accepted truth.

title: Hancom application and file code-control research
outputContract: capability <feature> -> api <exact-id> -> pinned source page plus actual qualification scope.
escalation: Use desktop/web/format/sdk explicitly; unsupported or untested behavior remains explicit.

title: Selected diagram marks/labels/fills without document reauthoring
outputContract: Versioned media-only HWPX patch, exact question-to-media bindings, unchanged-member proof and affected native visual check.
escalation: Changed canvas, aspect/size/crop/transform, owner or shared media requires a declared local-layout route; do not silently broaden the patch.

title: Whole-question selected-block transfer and format support
outputContract: Observed Q18 HWPML2X transfer counts, untouched clipboard, unsupported HWPX string path and separately documented file alternative.
escalation: Qualify only genuinely missing required behavior; do not rerun an unchanged prior transfer or substitute web signatures for desktop evidence.

title: Select original exam or reference presentation independently of file format
outputContract: Resolved profile/selection-required state, independent format and preserved content; both historical deliveries retained.
escalation: A new document without a profile requires a user layout choice; an existing profile is preserved absent a requested change.

title: Native model/Jev comparison and candidate evidence integrity
outputContract: Pinned raw answers, actual native/provider metrics, facet coverage and bounded diagnosis.
escalation: Do not infer independent child actor binding, general model ranking or causal savings from one diagnostic batch.
